title: Design: Reopen Work Order window shows its body and buttons
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have a closed internal work order, made for this test.
  • Start on its Finance tab.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow3-02-02-reopen-dialog.png, iwo-happy-37-37-reopen-work-order.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the invoice menu on the document.
  2. Click Reopen Work Order.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window "Reopen work order [number]?" opens with the body "The work order leaves Closed · Internal and goes back to Complete. The parts cost and shop supplies entries are reversed in your books."
  • Buttons Cancel then "Reopen Work Order".

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11761 (Story 4, Reopen a closed internal or no-charge work order)

  • S4-R2: “Reopen opens the dialog "Reopen work order [number]?" with the body "The work order leaves Closed · Internal and goes back to Complete. The parts cost and shop supplies entries are reversed in your books." (Closed · No Charge on a no-charge one) and the buttons Cancel and "Reopen Work Order". Dismissing the dialog in any other way does nothing.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
